answer.rationale: Prioritize a referral incentive among established customers: it has previously added qualified revenue without measurable retention harm. Do not respond with broad promotional pricing; the recovered price-sensitive SMB discount result produced a 12% 30-day retention decline despite short-term acquisition and revenue lift, which conflicts with the sustainable-revenue objective. Use a standard, bounded rollout because referral performance has not been validated specifically under this competitor-price-cut environment.
